messages.subject: shinySketch - an app for fun
parts:
Here’s a small fun app that I built as a way to learn Shiny. This is my first time using Shiny. I was helped immensely by a number of posts in this group (Joe, Winston, Ramnath, Samuel Jenness, among many others.)

It doesn’t do any useful analysis, but you can create your own “art.”

shinySketch: http://spark.rstudio.com/ram/shinySketch/

All suggestions and comments welcome.

Ram
